title.narrative: OEGI-Livestock Market Systems – Leader with Associates

description.narrative: (Kenya): The Livestock Market Systems (LMS) Leader with Associates (LWA) activity enables chronically vulnerable households and communities to pursue improved economic opportunities in the livestock market system. LMS LWA leads a coordinated effort with six Associate Sub-Awards to provide comprehensive assistance to vulnerable households and communities that often struggle to escape poverty due to complex risks and exposure to recurrent shocks and stresses. The LMS Leader collaborates with each of the six Associate Sub-Awards by serving as a support platform for USAID's resilience focus countries in the Horn of Africa, including Uganda, Kenya, Ethiopia, Somalia, South Sudan and Democratic Republic of Congo. The LMS LWA will use FY 2021 funds to administer grants under the associate awards in Kenya. The grant facility is designed to stimulate and partner with private sector businesses to catalyze economic development and community level grants to strengthen resilience capacities. Additionally, LMS Leader will continue to be the management platform for the Associate Awards issued under the LWA, with the aim of providing cost effective and centralized support, including centralized finance, procurement; operations; human resources; communications; monitoring and evaluation; and Geographic Information System services. LMS Leader will promote Kenya's sustainability by partnering with and strengthening the Kenyan county governments, private sector and civil society actors in the arid lands via the grant facility. These efforts will improve local actors' capacity to lead and develop a more robust, sustainable livestock market system in Kenya. These efforts will reduce the need for humanitarian aid and improve the economic vitality of areas and groups, including women and youth, that are most vulnerable to shocks and threats.$500,000 of funding within this IM contributes to meeting the required "Micro, Small and Medium-sized earmark".
